paragraphs.text: translated by
1. THIS holy hymn, sublime and seven headed, sprung from eternal Law, our sire discovered.
paragraphs.original: इमां धियं सप्तशीर्ष्णीं पिता न ऋतप्रजातां बृहतीमविन्दत् ।
paragraphs.translit: imāṃ dhiyaṃ saptaśīrṣṇīṃ pitā na ṛtaprajātāṃ bṛhatīmavindat |

paragraphs.text: Ayasya, friend of all men, hath engendered the fourth hymn as he sang his laud to Indra.
paragraphs.original: तुरीयं स्विज्जनयद्विश्वजन्योऽयास्य उक्थमिन्द्राय शंसन्
paragraphs.translit: turīyaṃ svijjanayadviśvajanyo'yāsya ukthamindrāya śaṃsan

paragraphs.text: 2. Thinking aright, praising eternal Order, the sons of Dyaus the Asura, those heroes,
paragraphs.original: ऋतं शंसन्त ऋजु दीध्याना दिवस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीराः ।
paragraphs.translit: ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛju dīdhyānā divasputrāso asurasya vīrāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Angirases, holding the rank of sages, first honoured sacrifice's holy statute.
paragraphs.original: विप्रं पदमङ्गिरसो दधाना यज्ञस्य धाम प्रथमं मनन्त
paragraphs.translit: vipraṃ padamaṅgiraso dadhānā yajñasya dhāma prathamaṃ mananta

paragraphs.text: 3. Girt by his friends who cried with swanlike voices, bursting the stony barriers of the prison,
paragraphs.original: हंसैरिव सखिभिर्वावदद्भिरश्मन्मयानि नहना व्यस्यन् ।
paragraphs.translit: haṃsairiva sakhibhirvāvadadbhiraśmanmayāni nahanā vyasyan |

paragraphs.text: Brhaspati spake in thunder to the cattle, and uttered praise and song when he had found them.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिरभिकनिक्रदद्गा उत प्रास्तौदुच्च विद्वाँ अगायत्
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatirabhikanikradadgā uta prāstauducca vidvām̐ agāyat

paragraphs.text: 4. Apart from one, away from two above him, he drave the kine that stood in bonds of falsehood.
paragraphs.original: अवो द्वाभ्यां पर एकया गा गुहा तिष्ठन्तीरनृतस्य सेतौ ।
paragraphs.translit: avo dvābhyāṃ para ekayā gā guhā tiṣṭhantīranṛtasya setau |

paragraphs.text: Brhaspati, seeking light amid the darkness, drave forth the bright cows: three he made apparent.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिस्तमसि ज्योतिरिच्छन्नुदुस्रा आकर्वि हि तिस्र आवः
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatistamasi jyotiricchannudusrā ākarvi hi tisra āvaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. When he had cleft the lairs and western castle, he cut off three from him who held the waters.
paragraphs.original: विभिद्या पुरं शयथेमपाचीं निस्त्रीणि साकमुदधेरकृन्तत् ।
paragraphs.translit: vibhidyā puraṃ śayathemapācīṃ nistrīṇi sākamudadherakṛntat |

paragraphs.text: Brhaspati discovered, while he thundered like Dyaus, the dawn, the Sun, the cow, the lightning.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिरुषसं सूर्यं गामर्कं विवेद स्तनयन्निव द्यौः
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiruṣasaṃ sūryaṃ gāmarkaṃ viveda stanayanniva dyauḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. As with a hand, so with his roaring Indra cleft Vala through, the guardian of the cattle.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रो वलं रक्षितारं दुघानां करेणेव वि चकर्ता रवेण ।
paragraphs.translit: indro valaṃ rakṣitāraṃ dughānāṃ kareṇeva vi cakartā raveṇa |

paragraphs.text: Seeking the milk-draught with sweat shining comrades he stole the Pani's kine and left him weeping.
paragraphs.original: स्वेदाञ्जिभिराशिरमिच्छमानोऽरोदयत्पणिमा गा अमुष्णात्
paragraphs.translit: svedāñjibhirāśiramicchamāno'rodayatpaṇimā gā amuṣṇāt

paragraphs.text: 7. He with bright faithful Friends, winners of booty, hath rent the milker of the cows asunder.
paragraphs.original: स ईं सत्येभिः सखिभिः शुचद्भिर्गोधायसं वि धनसैरदर्दः ।
paragraphs.translit: sa īṃ satyebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ śucadbhirgodhāyasaṃ vi dhanasairadardaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Brhaspati with wild boars strong and mighty, sweating with heat, hath gained a rich possession.
paragraphs.original: ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्वृषभिर्वराहैर्घर्मस्वेदेभिर्द्रविणं व्यानट्
paragraphs.translit: brahmaṇaspatirvṛṣabhirvarāhairgharmasvedebhirdraviṇaṃ vyānaṭ

paragraphs.text: 8. They, longing for the kine, with faithful spirit incited with their hymns the Lord of cattle.
paragraphs.original: ते सत्येन मनसा गोपतिं गा इयानास इषणयन्त धीभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: te satyena manasā gopatiṃ gā iyānāsa iṣaṇayanta dhībhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Brhaspati freed the radiant cows with comrades self-yoked, averting shame from one another.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिर्मिथोअवद्यपेभिरुदुस्रिया असृजत स्वयुग्भिः
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatirmithoavadyapebhirudusriyā asṛjata svayugbhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. In our assembly with auspicious praises exalting him who roareth like a lion,
paragraphs.original: तं वर्धयन्तो मतिभिः शिवाभिः सिंहमिव नानदतं सधस्थे ।
paragraphs.translit: taṃ vardhayanto matibhiḥ śivābhiḥ siṃhamiva nānadataṃ sadhasthe |

paragraphs.text: Maywe, in every fight where heroes conquer, rejoice in strong Brhaspati the Victor.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिं वृषणं शूरसातौ भरेभरे अनु मदेम जिष्णुम्
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ śūrasātau bharebhare anu madema jiṣṇum

paragraphs.text: 10. When he had won him every sort of booty and gone to heaven and its most lofty mansions,
paragraphs.original: यदा वाजमसनद्विश्वरूपमा द्यामरुक्षदुत्तराणि सद्म ।
paragraphs.translit: yadā vājamasanadviśvarūpamā dyāmarukṣaduttarāṇi sadma |

paragraphs.text: Men praised Brhaspati the Mighty, bringing the light within their mouths from sundry places.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिं वृषणं वर्धयन्तो नाना सन्तो बिभ्रतो ज्योतिरासा
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhayanto nānā santo bibhrato jyotirāsā

paragraphs.text: 11. Fulfil the prayer that begs for vital vigour: aid in your wonted manner even the humble.
paragraphs.original: सत्यामाशिषं कृणुता वयोधै कीरिं चिद्ध्यवथ स्वेभिरेवैः ।
paragraphs.translit: satyāmāśiṣaṃ kṛṇutā vayodhai kīriṃ ciddhyavatha svebhirevaiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let all our foes be turned and driven backward. Hear this, O Heaven and Earth, ye All-producers.
paragraphs.original: पश्चा मृधो अप भवन्तु विश्वास्तद्रोदसी शृणुतं विश्वमिन्वे
paragraphs.translit: paścā mṛdho apa bhavantu viśvāstadrodasī śṛṇutaṃ viśvaminve

paragraphs.text: 12. Indra with mighty strength cleft asunder the head of Arbuda the watery monster,
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रो मह्ना महतो अर्णवस्य वि मूर्धानमभिनदर्बुदस्य ।
paragraphs.translit: indro mahnā mahato arṇavasya vi mūrdhānamabhinadarbudasya |

paragraphs.text: Slain Ahi, and set free the Seven Rivers. O Heaven and Earth, with all the Gods protect us.
paragraphs.original: अहन्नहिमरिणात्सप्त सिन्धून्देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः
paragraphs.translit: ahannahimariṇātsapta sindhūndevairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ
